Eventual shifted equality is equivalent to polynomial equality and equality of the normalized root multisets R={(b_i-1)/a_i} and S={(b_i+1)/a_i-sigma}. Equating their sums forces sigma=(2/d)sum_i 1/a_i in (0,2], hence sigma=1 or 2. Sigma=2 forces every a_i=1. If sigma=1 and any a_j=1 then b_j=0 gives a root -1 in R but none in S; b_j=1 gives root 1 in S but none in R. Thus all a_i>=2 and averaging forces a_i=2 for every i. Coordinatewise product formulas prove both converses and unique shifts. Nonnested witness a=(1,3,6), b=(1,4,5) has matching root multisets {0,2/3,1} for shift1; d<=2 nonnested necessity follows from unit-fraction equation. Independently exhaustively tested 819 nested boxes in d=1,2,3 with a_i<=3 and three positive integer shifts each, using exact fractions and root multiset identities; every case matched theorem.
